_note: Live Toast catalog for the Maui (Kihei) location only. THIS IS NOT THE SAN DIEGO MENU and must never be used to populate menu.json, which is brand and San Diego. CLIENT_FACTS.md says Maui runs dishes of its own; this pull is the proof. Prices run $2.50 to $3.50 above the brand-level figures on every comparable item, several San Diego dishes are absent entirely, and several Maui dishes have no San Diego equivalent.
_nameIsNotProof: Matching names do not mean matching products. Maui's `Vegetable Ramen` is not menu.json's `Vegan Ramen`: different name, and its description says HM noodles rather than the spinach noodles that define the San Diego vegan bowl. Do not link it from /menu/vegan-ramen/ and do not treat it as vegan without Amanda confirming.
_hmNoodlesObservation: Every ramen here except Carnitas is described as `HM Noodles`, and Garlic Fried Noodle says `HM thick noodle`. Carnitas alone says `Egg noodles`. That is a sharper detail than the menu-label observation already recorded against SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md Open Decision #1: whatever HM denotes, it is applied selectively rather than blanket, which is what an inherited catalog tag would NOT look like. It still does not establish mechanism (made on site, shipped in, or bought in), so #1 stays open. Worth putting to Amanda.
_addressCheck: Address and phone in this pull match locations.json byte for byte. No NAP conflict.
